description: SYNTHETIC evaluation set for the G1 scam message analyzer. Every message was written for this project; names, numbers, UPI IDs and links are invented. Labels: scam_type, money_direction_claimed (null where the message is genuinely ambiguous and the field is not scored), asks_for_pin_or_otp.
